_competition_opportunity_note: Zero on purpose, and this is the record of why. competition_opportunity is measured by scripts/llm_citation_probe.mjs, whose query source is data/queries/evidence/evidence_queries.json - 71 queries with MEASURED Google Search Console demand (impressions, average position). The scorer scores data/intake/query_clusters.json - 9,179 phrasings mined from social sources with no demand evidence at all. The two sets share 0 exact matches and 0 near matches down to 0.82 similarity: they are disjoint by construction, not by a keying bug. Probing the mined phrasings instead would spend provider budget measuring queries nobody is known to have searched for, which is the opposite of this repo's demand-backed rule. So the component cannot be measured as wired, and a weighted input that cannot be measured is a number that decides page priority while resting on nothing. It is switched off rather than left silently redistributing. Raise it again only together with a probe source that intersects the scored population; validate:citation-signal-join hard-fails if the weight is non-zero and the two sets do not intersect.
